name: Dome spec: United States
description: The United States spec for the Dome generator: thin shell cover, strength, steel ratio and bar spacing from ACI 318.2 (2014 edition read), cover against earth from ACI 318-19, and the building code on sprayed concrete, loads, foam and frost. Every value names its code, section and how it was read. Not a substitute for the codes or an engineer.
author: CadCraft
